cell_identity: Samsung 18650 ICR 4000 mAh 3.7 V nominal, as tested by the BMS team (investigator instruction 2026-11-05).
cell_capacity_source: Investigator-specified BMS-team cell rating; not yet a measured capacity.
cell_table_policy: Existing team-characterized our params.xlsx OCV/3RC table unchanged; resistances not rescaled for 4 Ah (conservative sag). Replace with BMS-team 4 Ah measurements when available.
sizing_criterion: Smallest series count of the 4 Ah cell (1P) whose interval-level replay of the full 320 m tracked-swing mission at the slowest deadline-feasible requested pace keeps nonnegative voltage headroom from 25%, 95% and 100% starts with margin for faster governed speeds: 7S keeps >=4.90 V at pace from 25% (6S only 1.08 V). Faster requests are voltage-limited by design: full-speed (0.66 m/s, 29.9 V peak) fails on 7S at every start, so the feasible speed ceiling falls with SOC.
selection_evidence: Development probes 2026-11-05 (dirty source, branch review/tracked-swing-18650-pack): full 320 m fast request peak 29.878 V / 4.190 Wh; mission-pace request peak 20.978 V / 3.612 Wh; clean-source qualification recorded in RL-MPC-Monitor/runs/tracked-swing-18650-20261105-a.
